description: Gives a short account of a plan, about 300 words, so that you can pick the work up again without being sent the whole plan: the title, the planned runtime against the target, the counts of scenes, shots, characters and places, the thesis and journey, one line for each sequence and scene, the missing-details counts, and, if you pass the check result, the open findings by severity. Fetch it first when you come back to a film. The scene ids it lists are the ones to ask shoot_plan_slice for. Input: plan, a dpl.plan/1 object; optionally findings, the dpl.findings/1 document shoot_plan_check returned for this plan (without it the summary says no findings were given and does not run the checks; if they are for another revision of the plan, it says so). Output: dpl.summary/1. A plan that does not validate is refused with its diagnostics. No AI model runs. We don't keep the plan. We log a one-way fingerprint (hash) of it, its size, the tool, the type of client, the result and the time taken. Needs an agent key from a Shoot Plan account. Free, and it does not count toward the account's 3 free projects a month. Plans up to 8 MB and 120 calls a minute (5,000 a day).

findings.description: Optional: the dpl.findings/1 document shoot_plan_check returned for this same plan, exactly as returned.

plan.description: The plan itself: a dpl.plan/1 JSON object (not text inside a string). Call shoot_plan_format for the schema links and an example.

name: shoot_plan_summary
title: A short account of a plan, for when context is short
